chunks: Ali عليه السلام passed by a bondwoman who had bought meat from a butcher while she was saying, “Give me more.” So Ali عليه السلام said to him, “Give her more, for it is greater for blessing.”

key_terms.زِدْنِي: give me more; add extra to what was purchased
key_terms.زِدْهَا: give her more; add extra for her
key_terms.لَحْمًا: meat being bought in the transaction

ai.seo_question: How does Imam Ali عليه السلام teach generosity and blessing in trade?
ai.summary: This hadith depicts Imam Ali عليه السلام encouraging generosity in commercial dealing. It teaches that giving a little extra in a sale is a cause of greater barakah (blessing).
